data.name: Bhupal
data.long_meaning: Derived from Sanskrit 'Bhu' meaning 'Earth' and 'Pal' meaning 'Lord'. Bhupal is a name for one who rules or governs the earth. In Hindu mythology, Bhupal is a title given to various deities and rulers. It is also a common name among Hindu communities.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Bhupal" carries the weight of regal and powerful heritage. It is associated with rulers, leaders, and people who wield significant influence in their communities. In Hindu society, it is a name synonymous with the idea of authority and governance. Its usage can be traced back to the ancient Indian texts, where gods and heroes bearing this name are portrayed as powerful and just rulers.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name "Bhupal" signifies one's connection to the earth and the divine forces that govern it. It reminds us of the importance of being responsible for the world we inhabit, and the responsibility to govern ourselves and our actions wisely. It also signifies a deep respect for leadership and authority figures who embody the qualities of justice and compassion, and inspire us to be better versions of ourselves.

historical_references.reference: Bhupal was a Jat ruler of the Chauhan dynasty in Rajasthan. He is known to have ruled between 1150 AD and 1185 AD.
Bhupal was a Rajput warrior who is said to have led the defense of Chittorgarh against the Delhi Sultanate under Alauddin Khilji in 1303 AD. He was killed during the siege.

platforms: Indian Politics (BJP leader in Rajasthan assembly), Business (Real Estate), Entertainment (Bollywood films)
